key_insight: The proposed H₂ optimization framework designs riblet wall-normal profiles to maximally attenuate turbulence at a fixed spanwise spacing.
engineering_relevance: Systematic riblet shape optimization could guide drag-reducing surface design without exhaustive searches over predefined geometries.
method: Model riblets through volume penalization in linearized Navier–Stokes dynamics.
Recast penalization as a structured state-feedback operator.
Minimize steady-state velocity-fluctuation variance and riblet-induced dynamical augmentations while maintaining constant bulk flux.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports optimal profiles for fixed riblet spacing but provides no quantitative attenuation results or experimental validation.
watch_item: Turbulence attenuation in the linearized model does not by itself establish drag reduction in fully nonlinear flows.
paper_title: $H_2$-optimal riblet profiles for turbulence suppression in channel flows
